class.name: StyleBoxLayered
class.brief_description: A style box made of layers.
class.description: A [StyleBox] that draws a list of [StyleBoxLayer]s in order, so complex looks such as raised buttons with a depth, a rim, a highlight and a border can be built without code. The corners can be smooth, or stepped like pixel art. Content margins that aren't set place the content inside the [constant StyleBoxLayer.MODE_OUTLINE] layers, like inside the border of a [StyleBoxFlat]. Two layered style boxes are interpolated layer by layer, see [member StyleBox.transition_duration]. The layers at the same index must have the same mode, and layers that only one of the style boxes has fade in or out.

method.name: get_corner_radius
method.description: Returns the corner radius of the given [enum Corner].

method.name: set_corner_radius
method.description: Sets the corner radius of the given [enum Corner].

members.member: If [code]true[/code], smooth corners and skewed edges are antialiased. Only used with [constant STYLE_SMOOTH].
The size of the antialiased edges, like [member StyleBoxFlat.anti_aliasing_size]. Only used with [constant STYLE_SMOOTH] when [member anti_aliasing] is [code]true[/code].
Moves the content of the control without changing its size, for example to move the text of a pressed button down.
Number of segments of each smooth corner. Only used with [constant STYLE_SMOOTH].
The radius of the bottom-left corner.
The radius of the bottom-right corner.
The radius of the top-left corner.
The radius of the top-right corner.
The layers to draw, from the bottom to the top.
Size of the steps of pixel corners, skewed edges and soft edges. A corner radius equal to it cuts a single pixel. With [member snap], also the grid sizes are snapped to.

Skews all layers around the center of the style box, like [member StyleBoxFlat.skew]: the horizontal part moves the rows sideways, the vertical part moves the columns up and down. With [constant STYLE_PIXEL], the shape is drawn on a grid of [member pixel_size], so the skewed edges make stairs. [b]Note:[/b] With [constant STYLE_PIXEL] and a skew on both axes, every cell of the area is checked to find the shape, which is slow for large style boxes with a small [member pixel_size]. The shapes of the last few sizes are reused while the style doesn't change, also at other positions, but changing the size or the style every frame, e.g. in a transition, costs that each time. A skew on one axis only is fast.
If [code]true[/code], the rectangle is rounded to whole pixels, and the margins, offsets, widths and corner radii of the layers to multiples of [member pixel_size].
How the layers are drawn: with smooth corners and edges, or on a grid of [member pixel_size] for a pixel art look.

constants.constant: Stepped corners, like pixel art. Each step is [member pixel_size] large.
